new_information: The FAA announced that it had issued certification for Boeing’s 737 MAX-10.
The FAA issued an amended type certificate confirming the aircraft complies with applicable design and safety requirements.
The FAA issued an updated Production Limitation Record authorizing aircraft production.
With production approved, the aircraft can be delivered to domestic and foreign carriers.
Before granting approval, the FAA required the MAX-10 to incorporate improvements addressing requirements in the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act and NTSB recommendations.
The required improvements included flight-control-system updates with an enhanced angle-of-attack sensor.
